tasks.short: Assist the healthcare team with patient care and procedures

steps.what: Coordinate the immediate care plan and confirm team responsibilities
Assist with medical procedures and respond to changes in patient condition

tasks.design: Keep bedside team coordination and procedural assistance human. Existing patient information in {OTHER}, the clinical record system, supports care; no separate paperwork saving is assigned to this direct-care task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assistance depends on live patient and team conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported change removes direct clinical assistance.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected changes require timely clinical coordination.
tasks.human_edge: The therapist recognises deterioration and adapts physical assistance.
tasks.altitude: No change in bedside time or clinical authority.

evidence.claim: Bedside coordination and assistance remain human work in this scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is therapist participation in direct care; other professionals' time and separate chart maintenance are excluded.
Therapist confirms patient condition and team responsibilities in s1's25 hours; no structured readiness flag is assumed.
Existing clinical tools remain unchanged; zero incremental upkeep is justified by no new process.
research_questions: Is any repeated record preparation actually part of this task rather than chart maintenance?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 and zero upkeep. All bedside coordination and assistance are retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain patient identification and therapy charts

steps.what: Verify patient identity and capture pertinent therapy facts
Compose the patient chart entry from verified therapy facts

loop.purpose: Draft a therapy entry from therapist-provided facts
loop.input: Verified patient context, therapy facts and approved chart template
loop.output: Draft entry with source-linked facts and explicit missing fields
loop.check: Therapist verifies identity, treatment type, settings, response, timing and negations against the observations; missing facts cannot be inferred
loop.stop: One correction then manual charting if any material discrepancy remains
loop.why_not_simpler: Structured fields can copy directly but concise narrative needs interpretation of dictated or written observations

steps.what: Verify the complete entry and save it to the correct patient chart

tasks.design: Test templates and field reuse in {OTHER}, the clinical record system, before adding a bounded therapy-note draft. The therapist supplies facts, checks the whole entry and saves only the verified patient-specific version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Therapy facts are repeatedly converted into chart narrative.
tasks.enabler_now: Clinical scribes can draft notes for clinician validation and record integration.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong identity, settings or negation can materially change care information.
tasks.human_edge: The therapist knows what was observed and what remains uncertain.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft charting; clinical responsibility remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: Autoscriber drafts clinical notes for clinician validation and integration with named clinical record systems.
The proposed charting saving is an unmeasured respiratory-therapy scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is maintaining the therapy chart, excluding the treatment itself and team procedure assistance.

Therapist produces patient and encounter identity, therapy type, time, settings, observed response and uncertainty in s1's30 hours. Missing details trigger manual clarification, never inferred facts. Existing registration supplies patient demographics through unchanged intake work.
Test native templates first; no diagnosis or therapy decision is delegated. No ambient recording is required.
research_questions: Does drafting reduce total charting after complete clinical verification?

already_counted.description: Draft review and final chart verification

incremental.description: Review note errors and maintain templates

approvals.approved_version: Exact final therapy entry and patient encounter identity after edits; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R78, gross22 minus4 upkeep gives18 net. Low assumes only7 drafting hours removed because of complex entries; fact capture and final verification remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine therapy requirements compatible with physician orders

steps.what: Locate and verify current physician orders and relevant treatment information
Assess treatment type, method, duration, precautions and medication requirements
Resolve conflicts and confirm therapy requirements within authorised clinical scope

tasks.design: Configure a current-order view in {OTHER}, the clinical record system, to reduce navigation. The therapist still checks validity and all clinical details, determines requirements and resolves conflicts with the responsible prescriber.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current orders and observations can be spread across record screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing views can gather current records without interpreting treatment needs.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting therapy and precautions requires clinical judgement and authorised scope.
tasks.human_edge: The therapist reconciles orders with actual patient condition.
tasks.altitude: A little less navigation; treatment and prescribing rights do not change.

reach.learn: Order version and clinical discrepancy checks

evidence.claim: Native current-order views can reduce navigation without determining treatment requirements.

assumptions: Boundary is therapist determination and confirmation of requirements; prescription authoring and treatment delivery are outside it.

Physician produces signed order identity, encounter, therapy instructions, date and status through unchanged order-entry work. Therapist checks the source and captures unresolved questions in s1's9 remaining hours. Missing fields or unclear orders require manual lookup and prescriber clarification; no structured safety clearance is assumed.
Test native clinical views first. The change affects navigation alone, not clinical assessment.
research_questions: Can the current-order view reduce navigation while preserving source and status verification?

incremental.description: Maintain view filters and resolve missing records

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R94, gross6 minus2 upkeep gives4 net. Low assumes only2 hours navigation removed;85 hours assessment and confirmation remain unchanged.

tasks.short: Explain treatment procedures and allay patient fears

steps.what: Explore the patient's understanding and concerns about the treatment procedure
Explain the procedure, answer questions and check understanding and cooperation

tasks.design: Retain the bedside explanation and understanding check. Existing approved material in {DOCS} can support the discussion, but no material-preparation baseline is invented for this interpersonal task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fear and misunderstanding depend on the individual patient.
tasks.enabler_now: No new technology removes the need for responsive explanation.
tasks.still_hard: Distress, language needs and changing patient capacity.
tasks.human_edge: The therapist builds trust and adapts the explanation to the patient's response.
tasks.altitude: No change in contact time or responsibility.

evidence.claim: Patient-specific reassurance and checking understanding remain human work in this scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is live explanation, excluding separate treatment decisions and documentation.
Therapist elicits concerns and understanding in s1's30 hours. No structured fear score or ready-to-cooperate flag is assumed.
Existing approved materials remain baseline tools; no new upkeep is introduced, justifying zero incremental work.
research_questions: Which patient concerns need more individual explanation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 and zero upkeep. The design retains all patient conversation and understanding checks.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Small reductions in chart drafting and order navigation; direct care and patient communication stay central.
reach: Coordinate source checks with medical records staff
Develop bedside communication with critical care nurses
role.ambitious_version: A respiratory therapist who spends less time drafting records while retaining hands-on clinical and communication responsibility.
